falseSynonyms.zh: 起初不一定等於第一次 initially 說的是開始階段；某件事可以 initially 發生某種情況，但此前同類事情可能已發生過。
falseSynonyms.point: Initially, the service was free does not mean this was the first service of its kind.

falseSynonyms.zh: 起初通常暗示後來改變 at first 常建立『起初……後來……』對比，不一定表示人生／歷史首次。
falseSynonyms.point: At first I disliked it, but later I changed my mind.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性／結構不同 first 可作序數詞、副詞、形容詞，但不能在所有位置直接替代 for the first time。
falseSynonyms.point: She first visited Paris in 2020 = She visited Paris for the first time in 2020.

falseSynonyms.zh: 原先不等於首次 originally 表示最初的狀態、計劃或來源，重點是後來有改變。
falseSynonyms.point: The building was originally a school; this does not describe a first-time experience.

falseSynonyms.zh: 一次不等於第一次 once 可表示『一次』或『曾經』，不一定是第一次。
falseSynonyms.point: I visited once last year does not mean it was my first visit.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞，不是自由副詞替代 first-ever 通常修飾名詞：first-ever win / visit / event。
falseSynonyms.point: They won for the first time = They achieved their first-ever win.

falseSynonyms.zh: 新近不等於首次 newly 表示最近變成／剛剛完成，例如 newly opened。
falseSynonyms.point: A newly opened shop is new, but opening it is not the same grammatical meaning as for the first time.

falseSynonyms.zh: 終於不等於第一次 at last 表示經過等待／延誤後終於發生，重點不是它是否首次。
falseSynonyms.point: At last, the train arrived; it may have arrived many times before.
